controls.title: Account Management
controls.statement: Every account, role and service identity is created for a named purpose, owned, and removed when the purpose ends.
controls.look_for: New users, roles or service accounts; accounts with no owner or expiry; shared or generic identities.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.statement: Every request is checked against an explicit authorization decision before it touches a protected resource.
controls.look_for: Handlers or routes without an authorization check; checks done only in the client; allow-by-default branches.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.statement: Data moves only along flows that are declared and enforced, including between tenants and trust zones.
controls.look_for: Cross-tenant queries without a tenant key; new egress paths; data copied across accounts, regions or buckets.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.statement: Each identity holds only the permissions its task needs, scoped to the resources it touches.
controls.look_for: Wildcard actions or resources in policies; admin or root grants; permissions broader than the code path uses.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.statement: Remote and administrative access goes through an authenticated, encrypted and monitored path.
controls.look_for: Open SSH or RDP ports; bastion or console access without MFA; debug endpoints reachable from outside.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.statement: The system decides which security events it records, and records them.
controls.look_for: Auth, authorization, key use and admin actions with no log call; logging disabled on a new resource.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.statement: Each audit record says what happened, when, where, who did it and what the outcome was.
controls.look_for: Log lines missing actor, timestamp, resource or result; free-text logs where a structured record is needed.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.statement: Audit records are reviewed and suspicious activity is reported to someone who acts on it.
controls.look_for: New log groups with no alarm, metric filter or subscription; findings routed nowhere.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.statement: Audit records and logging settings are protected from change and deletion by the identities they record.
controls.look_for: Log stores writable or deletable by application roles; missing retention or immutability; logging that the app can turn off.

controls.title: Audit Record Generation
controls.statement: Every component that handles a security event generates the audit record itself.
controls.look_for: New services, functions or queues without logging configured; trails or flow logs not enabled.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.statement: The approved configuration is kept under version control and deployments come from it.
controls.look_for: Resources created outside code; manual console steps in docs; drift-prone defaults left implicit.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.statement: Security-relevant settings are set explicitly to their hardened values.
controls.look_for: Insecure defaults left in place; TLS, encryption or public-access flags unset; debug modes on.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.statement: Only the ports, services, features and packages the system needs are enabled.
controls.look_for: New open ports; unused services or packages; broad CORS; features enabled for convenience.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.statement: Staff and operators are uniquely identified and authenticated, with MFA for privileged and network access.
controls.look_for: Shared logins; privileged paths without MFA; authentication bypass flags.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.statement: Passwords, keys, tokens and certificates are generated, stored, rotated and revoked safely.
controls.look_for: Hardcoded secrets; tokens in config or logs; weak hashing; no rotation or expiry on keys and tokens.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users)
controls.statement: Customers and external callers are uniquely identified and authenticated before they get access.
controls.look_for: Anonymous endpoints that return tenant data; API keys with no caller binding; trust in caller-supplied identity headers.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.statement: Traffic crossing a trust boundary passes through a controlled interface that allows only what is declared.
controls.look_for: Security groups or firewalls open to 0.0.0.0/0; public subnets for private services; missing WAF or gateway in front of an API.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.statement: Data in transit is encrypted and integrity protected, including inside the network.
controls.look_for: Plain HTTP; TLS below 1.2; certificate verification turned off; unencrypted internal hops.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.statement: Keys are generated, distributed, stored, rotated and destroyed under a defined process, separated per tenant where data is.
controls.look_for: Key material in code or env vars; keys shared across tenants; rotation disabled; key policies broader than their users.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.statement: Only approved algorithms, modes and key sizes protect data.
controls.look_for: MD5, SHA-1, DES or ECB; custom crypto; short keys; random values from a non-cryptographic generator.

controls.title: Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
controls.statement: Certificates come from an approved authority under a defined issuance and revocation policy.
controls.look_for: Self-signed certificates in production paths; skipped chain or revocation checks; long-lived certificates with no renewal.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.statement: Stored data is protected, normally by encryption, wherever it rests.
controls.look_for: Buckets, databases, volumes, queues or backups without encryption at rest; plaintext sensitive fields.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.statement: Known flaws are found, fixed and the fix is tested and shipped within a set time.
controls.look_for: Pinned dependencies with published advisories; suppressed scanner findings with no tracked reason.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.statement: The system is monitored for attacks and unauthorized use, and alerts reach someone.
controls.look_for: New entry points with no monitoring; detection services disabled; alerts with no destination.

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.statement: Input is validated for type, length, range and format at the point it enters.
controls.look_for: Unvalidated request fields; string-built SQL, shell or paths; unsafe deserialization of caller data.

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.statement: Changes ship with security tests and analysis whose findings are fixed or tracked.
controls.look_for: Security-relevant code without tests; scanners removed from CI; tests weakened to pass.

controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools
controls.statement: Development follows a documented process with defined standards and pinned tools.
controls.look_for: Unpinned build tools or actions; process steps skipped; standards sources not declared.
